race.comment: STRAIGHT BLAST (8) had no luck off a wide gate on a heavy track in a tougher field at Eagle Farm 3 weeks ago, when following on from a big second by a neck here before that. He gets a superior draw here, steps up in trip, drops in class, and can take it out. FIRE AND LIGHT (1) failed to fire in a higher grade at Doomben a fortnight ago, after winning here over 1300m last month. A 2kg claim will offset his weight rise, and he can bounce straight back into the money here. MICHIFUKU (6) will find this much easier than his last run, and he should be peaking third up from a spell. He is worth keeping safe in all combos. MOCKRIDGE (4) has been thereabouts in 2 starts back from a spell. Stick with him.
